findings.summary: unplaceable_queued() in reckon/crew/queue_order.py re-implements the placeable/unplaceable partition that selection.py:233-239 already owns; the addition duplicates the owner rather than extending it, so the ordering and the admission pass now each carry their own policy for a pointer with no readable queued_at.

admission_order_details builds set_aside inline instead of calling the unplaceable_queued() helper added in the same change, so the public helper has no production caller (only the test uses it) and the reported behaviour comes from the log line while a second copy of the same predicate can drift from it.

test_the_admission_ordering_still_refuses_a_pointer_without_its_time asserts the ValueError that this change removes from admission_order, so the merged head carries one added failing test; the node was fenced out of this file and reported it under outside_scope, and the repair (invert the case to read the two placeable pointers ranked and UNREADABLE named by unplaceable_queued) must be folded into a node before the run's suite is green.

The module docstring is changelog prose ("the ordering used to refuse the whole pass", a dated incident narrative) which the repository's comment rule bans in source, and its closing sentence at line 13 is ungrammatical ("a queued pointer is never written without a readable arrival is stamped where it is missing"); the history belongs in the evidence fragment's article, not in the module.

VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that one unreadable queued pointer never fails admission ordering or a review compose; reckon/crew/queue_order.py:340-353 now leaves such a pointer out of the ordering and warns with its run id, and reckon/crew/runs.py:984-990 plus reckon/crew/admission/launching.py:610 and :741 stamp an arrival no writer supplies.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names three measures; the first is asserted by test_the_ordering_ranks_the_readable_pointers_and_names_the_set_aside_one, the second only approximately by test_a_queued_review_is_placed_while_an_unreadable_pointer_waits (it queues a review request and reads a position rather than composing a review), and the third only in part by test_no_writer_copies_an_arrival_it_has_not_read, which forbids copying another record's queued_at but does not assert every writer stamps a readable one; the gate ran both test files and the manifest records 58 passed EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon, tests/test_unreadable_queued_pointer_never_fails_ordering.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only reckon/crew/queue_order.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, reckon/crew/admission/launching.py, the named test file and the named fragment, so every path is inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read in full; it states tests 58 passed in 15.24s with EXIT=0 at e83916f1, base arm 51 passed at cd5e68ec, names both logs on disk, and names its declared negative control and the outside-scope test it supersedes.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against cd5e68ec — e83916f17f is the implementation and its test (4 files, +271/-5), 7fec441677 is the evidence fragment alone (1 file, +61); both carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution trailers.

SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:233-239 already owns the placeable/unplaceable partition and the unplaced verdict, and reckon/crew/queue_order.py:253-266 adds a second implementation of the same predicate without extending it.
FINDING reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:237 non-blocking: unplaceable_queued() and the inline set_aside duplicate the partition the admission pass already owns, so one policy now lives in two layers.
FINDING reckon/crew/queue_order.py:339 non-blocking: the ordering builds its own set_aside rather than calling the unplaceable_queued() helper added beside it, leaving that helper with no production caller.
FINDING tests/test_the_admission_pass_survives_a_pointer_without_its_time.py:300 non-blocking: the change inverts the refusal this existing test asserts, so the merged head carries one added failing test that must be folded into a repair node.
FINDING tests/test_unreadable_queued_pointer_never_fails_ordering.py:4 non-blocking: the module docstring is changelog prose with a broken sentence at line 13, where source should state the mechanism.
